name: Shimanto (Japan, town)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shimanto town emblem in green, blue and orange: a green ring enclosing a blue stylised figure with an orange head.
history: Municipal flag of Shimanto, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Shimanto town emblem — a green ring enclosing a blue stylised figure with an orange head
